messages:
Priya: Quick thread to lock down a 30-40m webinar: action-first, low jargon. working title suggestion: 'Inference Sprint: 3 production moves you can ship this sprint'.
Marco: love that. audience = PMs + infra engs. keep it under 40 so people stay.
Lila: format idea: 3x 8-minute deep-dive segments (each = problem + fix + metrics) then 8-10m Q&A. punchy.
Priya: agree. each segment should include a concrete artifact to hand off (notebook, script, checklist).
Ben: volunteers: I'll do the "batching" segment, Marco can do "cache strategy", Priya can host and do routing/quantization segment.
Marco: scheduling: two rehearsals — tech check (30m) and full run (45m). windows next Tue 09:30 PT or Thu 16:00 PT. which is better?
Lila: Thu 16:00 PT works for me.
Priya: book Thu 16:00 as full run, Tue 09:30 as tech check. Ben can do Tue for tech check?
Ben: yes Tue 09:30 is fine. I'll prerecord a 90s fallback for my demo.
DevBot: Rehearsal created: Tue 09:30 PT (tech check) and Thu 16:00 PT (full run). Links emailed.
Priya: draft abstract copy (1 line): "Ship lower-cost, lower-latency inference patterns in a sprint: batching, caching, and smart routing." keep it more visceral?
Marco: maybe add a stat: "Cut token spend by ~30% in customer pilots". if it's scrubbed it's okay.
Priya: we can use "~30%". good call.
Lila: landing page structure: one-line hook, 2-sentence blurb, 3 TL;DR bullets (one per lever), speaker bios (short), and a CTA "Get a free cost checklist".
Ben: demo plan (for my segment): show baseline gen at 1req/s with p95 high, then enable continuous batching with 8-request windows, show cost delta. will include exact CLI commands in drive.
Priya: add an ops snippet so users can health-check their endpoint during demo: `curl -fsS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq -r .uptime`
Marco: caching segment will demo prefix cache + KV reuse; I'll prepare a tiny reproducible notebook and a 2-slide visual showing cache hit vs miss.
Lila: routing segment will show fallthrough to a quantized variant for non-critical requests. keep it simple: toggle route -> show cost/loss tradeoff.
Ben: technical rehearsal ask: pin model versions and show fallback to quantized variant. command I'll add to drive: `export MODEL=redwood-2b && ./run_demo --model $MODEL --fallback redwood-2b-quant`
Priya: marketing tasks: 3 headline variants, one-sentence event blurb, and two social CTAs (LinkedIn + X). Marco can draft headlines.
Marco: I'll post 3 headlines by EOD. also propose we A/B test two hero CTAs on page: "Get the checklist" vs "See the demo".
Lila: follow-up assets: recording, 1-page checklist, notebook link, and a short "how-to" clip (90s). Ben will produce the 90s clip.
DevBot: Reminder: if a customer is on stage, legal release required 72h before event.
Priya: no named customer on stage for this one; we'll use sanitized pilot metrics only.
Ben: rehearsal checklist for tech: 1) mic/camera check 2) demo environment pinned 3) fallback clip ready 4) slides loaded to host view 5) recording confirmed.
Marco: I'll create presenter cue cards and share in the drive.
Lila: I'll draft the follow-up email (recording + checklist + CTA to request a cost review).
Priya: run-of-show draft (35-40m):
0:00 - 0:45 Welcome & goal (Priya)
0:45 - 8:30 Segment 1: Batching (Ben)
8:30 - 16:30 Segment 2: Caching (Marco)
16:30 - 24:30 Segment 3: Routing & quant (Priya)
24:30 - 30:30 Ops checklist & downloads (Lila)
30:30 - 38:00 Live Q&A + poll (All)
Ben: will upload demo notebook + fallback clip to drive tonight. link when ready.
Marco: headline options incoming.
Lila: will prepare the poll: "Which will you try first? (batching / caching / routing)"
Priya: great. next steps: Marco post headlines, Ben upload artifacts, Lila draft follow-up, DevBot confirms invites. See you at tech check. :rocket:
